description: This file defines the Attribute model class within the Opencart administration module. It manages CRUD operations for product attributes and attribute groups, including adding, editing, retrieving, and deleting attribute-related data from the database. It also handles related descriptions and relationships with other models.

classes.name: Attribute
classes.description: Model class for managing product attributes and attribute groups in the Opencart admin panel. Implements methods for CRUD operations, description management, and querying attribute data from the database.

methods.name: addAttributeGroup
methods.description: Creates a new attribute group and associated descriptions and attributes in the database.

methods.name: editAttributeGroup
methods.description: Updates an existing attribute group and its descriptions and attributes in the database.

methods.name: deleteAttributeGroup
methods.description: Deletes an attribute group, its descriptions, and related attributes from the database.

methods.name: getAttributeGroup
methods.description: Retrieves a specific attribute group record by ID.

methods.name: getAttributeGroups
methods.description: Retrieves a list of attribute groups based on filters and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalAttributeGroups
methods.description: Returns the total count of attribute groups matching filters.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a new description for an attribute group.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with an attribute group.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes descriptions associated with a specific language ID.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a specific attribute group.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a specific language ID.

methods.name: addAttribute
methods.description: Creates a new attribute under a specific attribute group, including descriptions.

methods.name: editAttribute
methods.description: Updates an existing attribute and its descriptions.

methods.name: deleteAttribute
methods.description: Deletes an attribute and its descriptions.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves an attribute record by ID.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves a list of attributes with optional filters, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalAttributes
methods.description: Returns the total number of attributes matching filters.

methods.name: getTotalAttributesByAttributeGroupId
methods.description: Returns the total number of attributes in a specific attribute group.

methods.name: addAttributeDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for an attribute in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteAttributeDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions for a specific attribute.

methods.name: deleteAttributeDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all attribute descriptions associated with a specific language ID.

methods.name: getAttributeDescription
methods.description: Retrieves a specific attribute description by attribute and language ID.

methods.name: getAttributeDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a specific attribute.

methods.name: getAttributeDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all attribute descriptions for a specific language ID.
